goal: Make wallet loading fail outright on a corrupted transaction record instead of silently rescanning forever
Ensures a corrupted record is surfaced clearly rather than left unresolved on every load
reviewability: Paused: waiting on author reply to a design concern and a reported bug in the new error message
Author has been silent for 17+ days on both open issues, so review would stall on unresolved questions
agreement: Multiple approach ACKs support failing fast over the old broken rescan behavior (pablomartin4btc, jonatack, rkrux, jeanpablojp)
Standing concern that users without backups could lose all fund access, not resolved by author (polespinasa)
Author acknowledged the tradeoff but did not change the approach

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes a real reliability defect where corrupted records persisted and rescanned forever without proper spend tracking
Benefits users who hit wallet corruption by giving an unambiguous failure instead of a broken repeating state
Not P1 since this is recovery UX for a rare scenario, not an active hazard, and the fund-access tradeoff is still disputed
